name: MiMoCode
install:
export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"
[ -x "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" ] || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s bun-v1.3.14
sudo ln -sf "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun || ln -sf "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun || true
git remote get-url upstream >/dev/null 2>&1 || git remote add upstream https://github.com/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-Code.git
git remote set-url --push upstream DISABLE
bun ci
